projection.tiling_note: Box-map boxy props; sheet goods read correctly at real 1.22 m sheet scale.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 1.2 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 0.4 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Workshop boards gather dust, scuffs and grime on edges.

materials.name: Chinked Log Cabin Wall
materials.description: Round log cabin wall with pale mortar chinking. Manufactured timber products: strand boards, plywood, butcher block and fiber boards.

projection.tiling_note: Box-map boxy props; sheet goods read correctly at real 1.22 m sheet scale.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 1.25 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 1.25 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Workshop boards gather dust, scuffs and grime on edges.
